title: Pass Through
description: A camera pass through travels through a wall, a body, or a window as if matter were optional. The path is continuous: one side of the barrier, its thickness, then the next space, without a cut.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Cut the building, not the film. A house can become a mechanism, a club a sequence of rooms, a body a door.
The audience is given omniscient access to geography. If you hide a cut on a passing truck, you have an invisible cut, not a pass-through.
The thickness of the wall or the flesh has to occupy the lens for a moment, or the cheat will read.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Build a 3D route or a set with a removable wall, then composite so objects keep thickness and shape. Lens behavior should stay coherent (no melting plaster).
Speed can ease through the barrier. Prompt: Pass-through of [Subject], the camera traveling through a wall, a body, a window as if matter were optional.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it to enter the next room without a cut, or to treat a house as a machine. Do not use it as a default transition between any two shots.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: Flying Cam Transition is a flight that punches a threshold and lands in a new room as a designed join. Through Object In uses a named prop (keyhole, cup) and often changes scale.
Object Portal is the object-as-door idea. FPV Drone can thread a real opening; pass-through may ignore matter.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Enter the Void flies through Tokyo rooms and bodies as if walls were optional. The Fight Club house tour treats a dwelling as a continuous mechanism.
Grammar: thickness, then the next space.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a cut on a dark frame or a passing object. The tell: a pop to a new room with no thickness.
The fix: travel through the barrier and keep its shape during the passage.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Pass Through in film?
A pass-through sends the camera through a wall, body, or window as a continuous path, treating matter as optional while keeping the next space coherent.
Pass Through vs Through Object In
Pass-through uses architecture or a body as the barrier. Through-object-in enters via a named prop such as a keyhole or cup, often with a scale change.
When should I use Pass Through?
Use it to change rooms without a cut, or to make a building feel like a mechanism. Do not use it as a cheap wipe.
How do I prompt Pass Through for AI image or video?
Name the barrier and the arrival space, and keep the path continuous. Example: Pass-through of [Subject], the camera traveling through a wall, a body, a window as if matter were optional.
